leadText:
Pokémon Concierge (Japanese: ポケモンコンシェルジュ Pokémon Concierge) is a series produced by dwarf studios as a collaborative production between Netflix and The Pokémon Company. The initial run consisted of four episodes, which were released worldwide on December 28, 2023 on Netflix. A second batch of four episodes was released worldwide on September 4, 2025 on Netflix. 

It was announced on February 27, 2023 during a Pokémon Presents as part of Pokémon Day. On February 19, 2024, the official Pokémon Twitter account announced that additional episodes were currently in production. From February 21 to March 9, 2025, episodes from Part 1 were made available on the various official Pokémon YouTube channels as a part of Pokémon Day 2025 celebrations. On February 27, 2025, during a Pokémon Presents as part of Pokémon Day, it was announced that the second batch of episodes will be released on Netflix in September 2025. On July 22, 2025, a new trailer was shown during Pokémon Presents.

It features a concierge at the Pokémon Resort, Haru, and her interactions with Pokémon and their s visiting the resort as guests.

On February 19, 2024, the official Pokémon Twitter account announced that additional episodes were currently in production. From February 21 to March 9, 2025, episodes from Part 1 were made available on the various official Pokémon YouTube channels as a part of Pokémon Day 2025 celebrations. On February 27, 2025, during a Pokémon Presents as part of Pokémon Day, it was announced that the second batch of episodes will be released on Netflix in September 2025. On July 22, 2025, a new trailer was shown during Pokémon Presents.

It features a concierge at the Pokémon Resort, Haru, and her interactions with Pokémon and their s visiting the resort as guests.

==Blurb==
 Welcome to Pokémon Resort, a peaceful getaway for Pokémon to relax and have fun. Which adorable guest will the new concierge Haru befriend and help first?
